biological_replicate: The text describes sample preparation and LC-MS/MS analysis but does not specify the number of distinct biological units (e.g., mice, patients) used for the proteomics experiment.
experimental_design: The text describes the identification of Kbz sites and characterization of enzymes, but does not explicitly define a comparative study structure like treated vs control or time course for the proteomics profiling.
factor_value: The text describes the identification of Kbz sites in yeast but does not specify distinct experimental groups or conditions (e.g., wild type vs mutant) for the primary proteomics profiling.
number_of_biological_replicates: No biological replicates are described or implied for the proteomics experiment; default value applied.
number_of_fractions: No fractionation or pre-fractionation is described in the LC-MS/MS analysis section; default value applied.
number_of_samples: The text describes the analysis of whole-cell lysates and histone samples but does not state the total number of biological samples run on the mass spectrometer.
number_of_technical_replicates: The text states that LC-MS identification was performed at least twice, but does not specify the exact count of technical replicates for the main experiment.
technical_replicate: The text states that LC-MS identification was performed at least twice, but does not provide a specific count or description of technical replicates.
technology_type: The samples were digested with trypsin and analyzed by LC-MS/MS, which is characteristic of bottom-up proteomics.
